tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The main brand colour. Fills, the mark, primary actions. Text on it is `on-primary`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: The second brand colour. Supporting fills and the mark's second tone.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one emphasis colour. One element per frame.

tokens.name: ground-light
tokens.usage: Video ground for light end cards and loops, in either theme.

tokens.name: ground-dark
tokens.usage: Video ground for dark end cards and loops, in either theme.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and plates, one step above `surface`; separate with `line`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative only.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and panel headings; the lower-third name.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Lower-third role line, emphasised runs inside body.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Notes under media, helper text, in `muted`.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Timecodes, counts and IDs, with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutters at phone width.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between stacked cards; lower-third inner padding.
